name: tasktick
description: A quiet place for your tasks and focused time.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.renderer.json && node scripts/build.mjs
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.renderer.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.e2e.json
scripts.test: npm run build && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --test dist-test/tests/*.test.js
scripts.format: prettier --write src tests e2e scripts *.json playwright.config.ts
